Consultation Sep 15 confirmed staying on 0.25 mg through pen 2 (last dose Sep 23); dose step to 0.5 mg deferred to ~Sep 30 with pen 3. Expected effects in force: RHR +4 bpm vs pre-initiation (49.3), HRV lower (32 vs 35.8 pre-initiation), appetite suppressed, weight loss expected. All autonomic shifts inside expected class effect; no second signal — not treated as red flags. Nutrition logging gap now 27+ days (since Aug 23) — on GLP-1 this is the leading fuelling/protein risk, not resolved.
